description:
Why this issue exists: auth_token.rs list_tokens() and revoke_token() derive the username from the AuthenticatedUser extension's username field, which is an Option<String>. In dev mode, basic_auth_middleware in server.rs injects a synthetic AuthenticatedUser with username = None (unwrap_or_default gives empty string). Meanwhile issue_token() uses the literal string 'dev'. This means tokens issued in dev mode (username='dev') cannot be listed or revoked via the API (which queries by username=''), and vice versa.

What needs to be done: Standardize the dev-mode synthetic user's username to the same literal used by issue_token ('dev'), or use a named constant DEV_USERNAME throughout. The empty-string fallback in list_tokens is silently wrong.
title: list_tokens/revoke_token: username is empty string in dev mode
